name: EPIC 212437036

text.card: A red giant 3,941 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.89 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,118 K at its surface.
